prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW mobile fantasy tower-defense upgrade-card illustration. Reference image 1 (archer skill) is the visual standard for a PERFECT CIRCULAR, FILLED illustration: continuous painted scene all the way to the circular rim, bold hand-painted comic shapes, strong foreground subject, vivid directional energy, excellent readability at 124 pixels. Reference image 2 is only the fire mage's orange/yellow flame and dark cracked ember palette. DO NOT copy the archer, bow, arrows or reference heart. The artwork is a perfectly round disk centered on a square 1024 canvas, disk diameter 98% of canvas. OUTSIDE the circular disk is truly transparent. INSIDE the disk every pixel must be fully painted and opaque, including all gaps between objects, using a rich deep red / burnt orange painted environment and firelight. No empty holes or transparent interior, no scattered isolated cutout objects, no rectangular corners, no decorative external rim, no letters, text, numbers or watermarks. Keep all flames, rocks and equipment INSIDE the circle. Large readable shapes should fill the disk; important subject occupies around 80 percent. No black empty void. Subject: a large glowing orange fireball, in the near foreground, splashes fire against two chunky dark armored training targets; small attached flames continue burning on both targets after impact. View close enough to read lingering ignition. Orange fire sweeping across a dark red smoky painted background with warm impact sparks. One coherent action scene, no gore, no modern objects.
